title: News External Link

fields.label: External Link
fields.name: external_link
fields.instructions: Optional. If set, this news card links out to this URL (opens in a new tab) instead of the internal post page — use this for press coverage hosted elsewhere. Leave blank and the card simply won't be clickable (title/image stay plain text/image, no "Read More" button).

description: Shown on every regular Post (Media News uses core Posts) so an editor can point a news card to an external article instead of the internal post page.
